findings.issue: The connective 'so' links two logically independent OPEN questions: the war-chest CAUSE of cash accumulation (why the firm holds cash) and the SOURCE of the CEO's uncertainty (compliance-constrained 'cannot speak' vs strategic 'will not speak'). The bright lines list these as SEPARATE open items. Read literally, 'the war-chest channel ... remains unestablished, so two readings ... remain observationally equivalent' implies the unestablished war-chest is what makes the compliance-vs-strategic readings equivalent. But resolving why firms accumulate cash would not resolve which reading of the hedging is correct, and failing to establish it does not cause that ambiguity; the two are independent. (A second, valid reading attaches 'so' to the broader 'establishes no mechanism' clause, under which observational equivalence does follow, so this is an ambiguous connective rather than a hard non-sequitur.) The intro mirror 1-P8-a keeps the two separate ('...offered as motivation, not identification -- while the source of the uncertainty ... remains observationally equivalent'), never invoking the war-chest, which shows the disambiguating fix touches no hedge.

Contrast intro mirror 1-P8-a, which separates them with 'while' and no war-chest clause.
findings.rule_broken: Connective ('so') asserts a cause/consequence relation between two premises that do not support it -- two independent open questions (cash-accumulation CAUSE vs uncertainty SOURCE) falsely linked, where the bright lines hold them open separately.
